title: Nvidia leadership stability: Madison Huang retains role after father's departure
digest:
Nvidia has retained Madison Huang as a senior executive despite her father Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO on Nov 16 2026. Crypto Briefing reported on Nov 18 that Huang continues as senior director of product marketing for physical AI, with her retention signaling internal stability during leadership transition.

Jensen Huang's departure followed months of board-level tensions over Nvidia's AI strategy. His successor Colette Kress faced market skepticism about her permanent CEO appointment but Huang's continued involvement addresses potential power vacuum concerns. The report notes that Nvidia's stock price showed limited reaction to the leadership changes, with analysts attributing this to the company's established AI market position.
